entries.title: I Chronicles 23:1
segments: And David was old and full of days, and he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:2
segments: And [he] gathered all the rulers of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:3
segments: And the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward. And their number by their heads, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:4
segments: Of these, twenty-four thousand [were] to set forward the work of the house of the LORD, and six thousand officers and judges.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:5
segments: And four thousand [were] gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which [David] made for praising.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:6
segments: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:7
segments: Of the men of Gershon [were] Laadan and Shimei.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:8
segments: The sons of Laadan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:9
segments: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These [were] the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:10
segments: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four [were] the sons of Shimei.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:11
segments: And Jahath [was] the chief, and Zizah the second. But Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons. Therefore they were in one roster, according to [their] father's house.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:12
segments: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:13
segments: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was separated so that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to Him, and to bless in His name forever.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:14
segments: And [as to] Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:15
segments: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:16
segments: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel [was] the chief.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:17
segments: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:18
segments: Of the sons of Izhar, Shelomith [was] the chief;

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:19
segments: of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:20
segments: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:21
segments: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:22
segments: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but had daughters. And their brothers, the sons of Kish, took them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:23
segments: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:24
segments: These [were] the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers, the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their heads, the ones who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:25
segments: For David said, The LORD God of Israel has given rest to His people so that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever,

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:26
segments: and also to the Levites, so that they shall no [more] carry the tabernacle, nor any of its vessels for its service.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:27
segments: For by the last words of David the Levites [were] numbered from twenty years old and above,

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:28
segments: because their office [was] to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:29
segments: both for the showbread, and for the fine flour for food offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all kinds of measure and size,

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:30
segments: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at evening.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:31
segments: And [they] were to offer all burnt sacrifices to the LORD in the sabbath, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded to them, continually before the LORD,

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:32
segments: and that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the Holy Place, and the charge of their brothers, the sons of Aaron, in the service of the house of the LORD.
